fusions.name: Hold Them Under
fusions.desc: A downward shove that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, and leaves it [Soaked] for 8 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled Counter
fusions.desc: A return blow that deals 26 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at 2.5 tiles, and always crits. Its damage rises 10% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 50%).

fusions.name: Water off Steel
fusions.desc: Sheds up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Preen Oil
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 6% and your water resistance by 12%.
